acceptanceCriteria: Determine whether `corvint affected --base` selects tools/fixture-maintenance-check for a change that adds a new *_test.go invoking `git commit`; if not, make it select the guard (or add the guard to the focused-test route in docs/DOGFOOD.md / the lane checklist), with a focused test or recorded affected-plan evidence.
body: Observed 2026-10-08 on batch J (beamfall/corvint#697, CI run 37856324507, job go-product-shard (3)). New test fixtures in internal/stepnegation and internal/testplan ran `git commit` under a hidden global config without `-c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0`; tools/fixture-maintenance-check TestRepositoryGitFixturesDisableDetachedMaintenance failed in CI only. The lane and batch focused runs (the changed packages plus doc gates) never ran the guard because it lives in a separate tools package that scans the whole repository. Suspected gap, not yet confirmed against `corvint affected`: a change that adds a *_test.go git fixture may not select tools/fixture-maintenance-check. Fixed in batch J commit 91d1ca85.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#700 (merge 986cec7c); focused tests, doc gates, dogfood bind/check/seal and independent review passed; evidence is the sha256 of the lane and batch build-logs at the merge commit.

title: Repository-wide fixture-maintenance guard runs only in CI, so lane focused tests miss new git fixtures
